qpdf.purpose: Structural PDF validation (qpdf --check). Not a PDF/A or PDF/UA validator.
qpdf.availability: Installed on the Linux CI runner; optional elsewhere.

verapdf.purpose: PDF/A and PDF/UA validation. Output is recorded for future profile work and is not a current claim.
verapdf.availability: Optional; the quality tool records it when present.

notes: The library does not currently claim PDF/A or PDF/UA conformance.
The legacy DocumentMetadata.PdfA flag is not a validated profile.
